- Refinery Gas: the lightest cut of Crude Oil, a gas. Burns at 1,150°C in the Fuel Burner and the Gas Turbine Array.
- Naphtha: the hottest liquid Fuel Burner fuel (1,200°C), so it can boil Superheated Steam. Catches fire in the world.
- Kerosene: a clean, hot fuel (1,150°C). Catches fire in the world.
- Light Oil: burns at 1,000°C.
- Diesel: burns at 1,050°C. Catches fire in the world.
- Heavy Oil: a long, cool burn (750°C), and a steam turbine lubricant.
- Bitumen: the bottom of the barrel, thick as tar.

- Pitch: a long-burning furnace fuel. Spin it into Carbon Fiber in a Fiberizer (1,000°C); Carbon Fiber makes Arcforged Alloy.
- Asphalt: 8 gravel around 1 pitch makes 8. You walk, run and ride about 30% faster on it, and on its slabs and stairs.
